text:
alex: opened PR #4827 — onprem KMS handoff + networking tweaks. needs security eyes for secrets rotation flow and the NAT/VPC changes before we merge. link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4827

mira: thanks — adding to my queue. is this going to touch the private control plane endpoints?

alex: yes, two changes: (1) terraform for kms key policy and key ring binding, (2) a small route/NAT change to allow the onprem box to reach KMS via a transit gateway.

jon: pinging for quick risk check: do we have a fallback if the KMS key is unavailable during deploy? want to avoid broken rollouts.

alex: good call. PR includes a migration step: new key is created, configs updated to support dual-key read for 48h, then old key scheduled for rotate. section in PR:```hcl
resource "google_kms_crypto_key" "onprem_key" {
  rotation_period = "2592000s" # 30d
}
```

mira: can you add an explicit rollback plan in the PR description (steps + who to ping)? makes approvals easier.

alex: done — added rollback steps and a runbook link. also noted that the NAT change only adds an egress route to the existing TGW, not inbound rules.

security-bot: automated scan: detected usage of plaintext secret in tests/test_seed.sh line 14. flagged for fix before merge. (rule: no-plaintext-secrets)

alex: own that, will scrub test and push fix in a follow-up commit.

jon: I can review the KMS policy tonight. rough ETA 2-3h. if I spot anything blocking I'll post inline comments on the PR.

mira: after jon + security thumbs we can schedule merge during the 10:30–11:30 UTC merge window today. alex, can you mark the PR WIP until then?

alex: yep marking WIP and will request final approval once tests pass.

deploy-bot: reminder: merge window for infra team is 10:30–11:30 UTC. any changes outside window need oncall sign-off.

mira: also, flagging compliance: please attach the dataflow diagram in the PR (network + KMS access path) so privacy can skim.

alex: added diagram.png to the PR. thanks.

jon: quick note — will validate that transit gateway route only allows egress to KMS endpoints (no broad 0.0.0.0/0).

alex: confirmed — route is to the KMS prefix list only.

mira: great. if jon + security-bot are clean, I'm good to approve. :thumbsup:
